commit.message:
fix(task): show each status's own color in the status filter without a space (#11154)

In All Issues (and other views without a space or selected project type) the status filter rendered each status presenter with space undefined and no project type. The presenter could therefore not find the project type's per-status configuration and fell back to the status category color, so all statuses of one category looked the same, unlike the issue list.

When no space is known, the filter now resolves a project type per status via a new getStatusProjectType helper: the selected project type if any, otherwise a joined project type that configures a color or icon for the status, otherwise the first joined project type containing it. The result is passed as projectType to the presenter. Views with a space are unchanged.

Fixes #5696

Signed-off-by: Michael Uray <michaeluray@users.noreply.github.com>
Co-authored-by: Michael Uray <michaeluray@users.noreply.github.com>

+
+import type { IdMap, Ref, Status } from '@hcengineering/core'
+import type { ProjectStatus, ProjectType, TaskType } from '@hcengineering/task'
+import { getStatusProjectType } from '../statusProjectType'
+
+const status = 'status-a' as Ref<Status>
+const other = 'status-b' as Ref<Status>
+
+function projectType (id: string, statuses: Array<Partial<ProjectStatus>>): ProjectType {
+  return {
+    _id: id as Ref<ProjectType>,
+    statuses: statuses.map((it) => ({ taskType: 'tt' as Ref<TaskType>, ...it }))
+  } as unknown as ProjectType
+}
+
+function typesMap (...types: ProjectType[]): IdMap<ProjectType> {
+  return new Map(types.map((it) => [it._id, it]))
+}
+
+describe('getStatusProjectType', () => {
+  const plain = projectType('plain', [{ _id: status }])
+  const colored = projectType('colored', [{ _id: status, color: 5 }])
+  const unrelated = projectType('unrelated', [{ _id: other, color: 3 }])
+  const types = typesMap(plain, colored, unrelated)
+
+  it('uses the selected project type when present', () => {
+    expect(getStatusProjectType(status, unrelated._id, types, [plain._id, colored._id])).toBe(unrelated._id)
+  })
+
+  it('prefers a joined project type that configures the status color', () => {
+    expect(getStatusProjectType(status, undefined, types, [unrelated._id, plain._id, colored._id])).toBe(colored._id)
+  })
+
+  it('falls back to the first joined project type containing the status', () => {
+    expect(getStatusProjectType(status, undefined, types, [unrelated._id, plain._id])).toBe(plain._id)
+  })
+
+  it('returns undefined when no joined project type contains the status', () => {
+    expect(getStatusProjectType(status, undefined, types, [unrelated._id, 'missing' as Ref<ProjectType>])).toBe(
+      undefined
+    )
+  })
+})

+// limitations under the License.

+
+import type { IdMap, Ref, Status } from '@hcengineering/core'
+import type { ProjectType } from '@hcengineering/task'
+
+/**
+ * Resolve the project type used to present a status when no space is known (e.g. All Issues).
+ * The selected project type wins; otherwise a joined project type that configures a color or icon
+ * for the status is preferred, falling back to the first joined project type that contains it.
+ *
+ * @public
+ */
+export function getStatusProjectType (
+  status: Ref<Status>,
+  selectedProjectType: Ref<ProjectType> | undefined,
+  projectTypes: IdMap<ProjectType>,
+  joinedProjectTypes: Array<Ref<ProjectType>>
+): Ref<ProjectType> | undefined {
+  if (selectedProjectType !== undefined) return selectedProjectType
+  let fallback: Ref<ProjectType> | undefined
+  for (const typeId of joinedProjectTypes) {
+    const projectStatus = projectTypes.get(typeId)?.statuses?.find((it) => it._id === status)
+    if (projectStatus === undefined) continue
+    if (projectStatus.color !== undefined || projectStatus.icon !== undefined) return typeId
+    fallback = fallback ?? typeId
+  }
+  return fallback
+}
